**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 4.9(a)).**

- **Section 7.4 (royalty audit)** — compliant, essentially at the preferred position: once per Calendar Year, one inspection per quarter, reasonable prior written notice at reasonable times, independent nationally recognised accounting firm reasonably acceptable to Ono and bound by confidentiality, Array bears cost absent an underpayment above the (redacted) threshold, and no system-access language. Only the un-fixed notice period and the redacted percentage were noted, not flagged.
- **Section 4.9(a) (facility/records inspection)** — fails the fallback: open-ended frequency (walk-away territory), no fixed notice, no cost allocation, no confidentiality undertaking. Redline validated (ok:true) adding a once-per-Calendar-Year cap, 30 days' prior written notice, Array-borne cost and Article 10-level confidentiality, while preserving Array's on-site regulatory-compliance inspection.
